description: Markup typed with tags out of order and the tree the browser repairs it into.

description: The same document with default styles, no styles, and a stylesheet, switched with one control.

description: A layout under a viewport width you drag, with the active media query shown.

title: Truthy and falsy
description: Values dropped into an if, with the eight falsy values marked.

description: A string method called on a variable, the new string it returns, and the original unchanged until the result is assigned back.

description: A function handed to another function and run later, beside the version with parentheses that runs it at once.

description: A function expression and its arrow form, with each part of one highlighted in the other as you switch.

description: A method called on its object and the same function called detached, with what this is in each.

title: A stale response

description: A request in flight cancelled by its controller and the rejection that follows.

title: The module graph
description: Files that import each other drawn as a graph, with an export followed to every import.

description: Several promises started together and the single result that waits for the slowest.

description: A ref changed without a render beside state changed with one.

title: The URL as state
description: Search parameters and the UI that reads them, changed from either side.

description: Stateful code inside a component folded into a hook, with the same calls shown in both places.

title: Terminal
description: A scripted command session you advance one command at a time, with each command's output.

description: A browser trying to load import "react" with nothing to resolve it, and the bundler that fills the gap.

description: A request served by the dev server, transformed on demand, beside the same page served from dist/.

description: A package.json with each field named when selected, and the script that npm run dev expands to.

description: A dependency pulling in its own dependencies, the tree that results, and the lockfile that pins it.
